description: Gets TraceTail API keys for the person you work for: returns a link to give them, where they sign in with an emailed code and add a card or continue without a card, and a token. Then call check_setup_link with its id and token every few seconds: once they've finished, it returns an API key for each site (and a server key if you asked), once.

domains.description: The sites to create API keys for, like ["example.com", "localhost"]; include localhost for local development.

email.description: The person's email, if you know it: it prefills the page.

serverKey.description: Also create a server key, so the backend can verify identifications.

name: create_setup_link
title: Create a TraceTail setup link
